name: Supine 360-Degree Breathing

instructions.description: Lie on the back with knees bent and hands around the lower ribs.
Inhale gently and feel expansion toward the front, sides, and back.
Exhale slowly while keeping the jaw and shoulders relaxed.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record a comfortable breathing rate without prescribing a universal norm.

variations.variationDescription: Supine 360-Degree Breathing — Shorter Practice Version: Use a shorter comfortable practice period while preserving relaxed breathing.

commentsNotes: Use head or knee support for comfort.
